foreman.name: The Sludge Foreman
foreman.description: Fight through Saltmarket Street and Canal Works, then defeat the Sludge Foreman.

dialogue.offer: Ama's stall got shaken down again tonight. The crew ran off down Saltmarket Street, and they left a crate behind. Knock some sense into them. The canal stinks worse every night, and the boar-masked brute who runs the pumps is the reason. Shut him down.
dialogue.active: He works the pumps at the far end of Canal Works.
dialogue.done: They came back for that crate before I could open it. All I kept was this label. A factory stamp on a crate street punks fight over? Doesn't add up. A delivery note, stamped and signed for a warehouse that burned down years ago. Forged. They're moving freight through South Street on paper that can't be real.

the_pit.name: The Pit
the_pit.description: Fight from Rusted Corner past the Night Market, then defeat the Pit Champion at the Fight Club.

dialogue.offer: Since the Foreman went down, kids are lobbing bottles at anyone who walks the Rusted Corner. Somebody pays them to keep that road empty. Find out why. Kenji says anyone who wants work at the refinery has to fight the Baron's champion first, in a ring in the alley behind the Night Market. The back door to the Baron runs through him.
dialogue.active: The Fight Club meets in the alley past the Night Market. Watch his wind-up; he hits like a truck.
dialogue.done: He fought for the Baron to clear his mother's debts. He's done with that now. The back door to the Refinery is open.

furnace_baron.name: The Furnace Baron
furnace_baron.description: Fight through the Refinery and the Rat Nest, then defeat the Furnace Baron at Gang HQ.

dialogue.offer: The Baron melts stolen scrap in that refinery, and his enforcers run it for him. Break their hold on the smelter. Every collection on this street is counted in that building. The Baron is inside with what's left of his crew. End it.
dialogue.active: The Gang Headquarters stand past the Rat Nest.
dialogue.done: His ledger. The same payment every week, from an account at the port, marked 'for the route'. The Baron was only renting this street. Somebody bigger is paying.

ends_chapter.title: Chapter 1 complete
ends_chapter.subtitle: South Street is safer. The money trail leads to the Port District.

harbourmaster.name: The Harbourmaster
harbourmaster.description: Fight from Port Road through the Freight Market and the Container Yard, then defeat Harbourmaster Chen.

dialogue.offer: The Baron's ledger brought you here? Then you've seen the same money I have. The stevedores who take it now lean on every stall on this road. Knock down 6 of them. Chen decides which crates leave this port and which papers go with them. Stop him. He'll drop a container on you if you stand still, so keep moving.
dialogue.active: The Crane Yard is past the Container Yard. When the red shadow grows under you, move.
dialogue.done: His manifest. Someone scratched out the destination and wrote in a factory in the Industrial District, and stamped it with the same mark as that first crate. This goes deeper than the port.

ends_chapter.title: Chapter 2 complete
ends_chapter.subtitle: The port is quiet. The cargo leads on to the Industrial District.

the_chief.name: The Chief
the_chief.description: Fight through the Factory Gate, then defeat the Security Chief on the Production Line.

dialogue.offer: You found the manifest? Then you know where the sludge comes from. I need samples from inside that factory to prove it, and the guards won't let a former inspector through. Knock down 6 of them. Nattapong guards the way to the waste pools. Beat him, but don't break him. He may be the only one in there who'd listen.
dialogue.active: He's at the end of the Production Line. Watch his rush once he's hurt.
dialogue.done: He sat on a crate and said he never asked what the pools were for. Then he took his badge off and walked out the gate. One less guard. Maybe one more witness.

unit_k7.name: Unit K-7
unit_k7.description: Fight through the Waste Pools, then defeat Unit K-7 in the Factory Drains.

dialogue.offer: The pools are guarded by machines now, not people. Clear 6 of them and I'll fill my jars. This is the proof I've waited six years for. The heat comes from the drains under the factory, and something big guards them. A machine they call K-7. Stop it and bring me whatever it's protecting. Mind the vents, they burst when it's near.
dialogue.active: The Factory Drains are past the Waste Pools. Step off a hissing vent before it bursts.
dialogue.done: Here, keep a jar. It's the same sludge as the canal. And it's warm. Something under this factory is running hot, day and night. Their log. Readings, failures, and one name underlined twice: The Core. Whatever it is, it's still running, and someone at the top wants it kept that way.

ends_chapter.title: Chapter 3 complete
ends_chapter.subtitle: The Core is real, and still running. Who protects it?

the_ring.name: The Ring
the_ring.description: Fight down Warehouse Row, then defeat the Ringmaster in the Underground Ring.

dialogue.offer: You found me. Yes, I carried their envelopes. I never opened one, and I should have. The runners bring the cash through these warehouses. Knock down 6 of them and I'll show you where it goes. The Ringmaster runs the fights and keeps the takings. Beat him in his own ring and the books will have nobody to guard them.
dialogue.active: The Underground Ring is past Warehouse Row. Watch his spinning kick: it reaches both sides.
dialogue.done: He says the ring only ever lost money. The real books are kept upstairs, in the Counting House, by Big Sak's men.

big_sak.name: Big Sak
big_sak.description: Fight through the Counting House, then defeat Big Sak in Rattanachai Tower.

dialogue.offer: The Counting House is where the cash becomes clean. The enforcers guard the transfer slips. Knock down 6 of them and bring me the slips. Big Sak runs South Street and the port, and he never fights alone. He whistles and his runners come. Beat him and he might finally talk.
dialogue.active: Rattanachai Tower is the end of the line. When he whistles, deal with his runners fast.
dialogue.done: Every slip carries the same signature: Director Wiroj, Kraisorn Heavy Industries. Big Sak never asked what he was paid for. He's in his tower. He'll ask now. He talked. He thought he was moving goods for a factory, not keeping a city quiet. His pass opens the Core Facility, and the final activation is in seven days.

ends_chapter.title: Chapter 4 complete
ends_chapter.subtitle: The Core Facility goes live in seven days.

subject_twelve.name: Subject 12
subject_twelve.description: Fight through the Core Facility Gate, then defeat Subject 12 in the Test Labs.

dialogue.offer: Big Sak's pass gets us to the gate, not through it. The troopers here answer to Commander Arthit, not the gangs. Knock down 6 and we're in. The green-skinned ones in the labs were workers. Months beside The Core, and it changed them. The biggest guards the way on. They call him Subject 12. Stop him, don't hate him.
dialogue.active: Subject 12 is at the far end of the Test Labs. His lunge carries him a long way: get out of its line.
dialogue.done: His band has a name on it, a canal dredger from South Street. The lab's own report says it reverses if the exposure stops. So we stop it.

commander_arthit.name: Commander Arthit
commander_arthit.description: Fight through the Machine Hall, then defeat Commander Arthit in the Control Room.

dialogue.offer: The Machine Hall feeds The Core its power. Arthit's riot squad holds it. Knock down 6 and the Control Room door is ours. Arthit guards the Control Room. The floor there is laced with security lasers: when the red line crosses your lane, change lanes or roll through it. Bring me whatever runs The Core.
dialogue.active: The Control Room is past the Machine Hall. When the red line crosses your lane, step off it or roll.
dialogue.done: The source data. The Core was built to clean the canal, and it worked, until they pushed it past its limits and hid every failure. The final activation will push it further. Wiroj is in the main control centre. It ends there.

ends_chapter.title: Chapter 5 complete
ends_chapter.subtitle: The final activation will spread the damage. Wiroj waits at the centre.

the_walkway.name: The Walkway
the_walkway.description: Fight from the Core Approach through the Cooling Tunnels, then defeat the Core Sentinels on the Reactor Walkway.

dialogue.offer: This is it: the main control centre. Ama brought half of South Street's kitchen to feed us. The last of Arthit's troopers hold the approach. Knock down 6. The sentinels answer only to the Director. Knock down 6 on the walkway and nothing stands between you and him.
dialogue.active: The Reactor Walkway is past the tunnels. Knock down 6 Core Sentinels.
dialogue.done: He's in the Core Chamber. When the defences come up, he hides behind them. Survive the system, and hit him when it resets.

the_iron_legacy.name: The Iron Legacy
the_iron_legacy.description: Defeat Director Wiroj in the Core Chamber.

dialogue.offer: Wiroj will fight in his protective suit, then behind the chamber's defences, then with nothing left to lose. Steam, the floor plates, the lasers: they come in a rhythm. Learn it. Then end this.
dialogue.active: The Core Chamber is past the walkway. When the shield is up, survive. When the system resets, strike.
dialogue.done: The Core is shut down. Wiroj is in cuffs, and every page of it is evidence now. It's over. Not the work, but the fight.

ends_chapter.title: The Iron Legacy
ends_chapter.subtitle: The Core is shut down. The city remains.
epilogue: Ama's stall and the Night Market stalls open again, and nobody comes to collect.
Chief Odo calls the first community meeting in years. He stands at the front this time.
Dr. Pim hands the evidence to the city's inspectors in person. This time they read it.
Big Sak testifies. Security Chief Nattapong testifies too.
Kraisorn Heavy Industries is under investigation, and Director Wiroj answers for The Core.
The night shift goes home. Slowly, the green fades.
The canal will take years to run clean. Winning a fight is not the same as fixing a city. But it is a start.
